name: DB_Projects
title: Projects
description: Short-term endeavors with specific goals and fixed deadlines (P in P.A.R.A.)

Area.description: The sphere of life this project belongs to

Tasks.description: All actionable tasks for this project

Notes.description: Research, meeting minutes, and notes related to this project

Progress Bar.expression: let(total, prop("Tasks").length(), done, prop("Tasks").filter(current.prop("Status") == "Done").length(), percent, if(total > 0, round(done / total * 100), 0), barLength, 10, filled, round(percent / 10), empty, barLength - filled, if(total == 0, "⚪ No Tasks", repeat("▓", filled) + repeat("░", empty) + " " + percent + "% (" + done + "/" + total + ")"))

Health.expression: let(total, prop("Tasks").length(), done, prop("Tasks").filter(current.prop("Status") == "Done").length(), isDone, prop("Status") == "Completed" or (total > 0 and done == total), deadline, prop("Deadline"), daysRemaining, if(empty(deadline), 999, dateBetween(deadline, now(), "days")), ifs(isDone, "✅ Completed", daysRemaining < 0, "🔴 Overdue by " + abs(daysRemaining) + "d", daysRemaining <= 3, "🟡 Due Soon (" + daysRemaining + "d left)", "🟢 On Track"))
